verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a GraphQL platform API and an OpenAPI file, but nothing shows API versioning or a published deprecation policy. The 'promote versions' mention refers to app deployment versions, not API versioning, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. Versioning and deprecation policy are a fair axis for a SaaS API platform, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
